message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.55,"fairness_assessment":"A structured social-choice vote fairly compares visibility, educational value, and budget efficiency, while preventing the strongest single argument from deciding the outcome alone.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"Agent A","position":"Prioritizes an inter-city tournament, buffet, and prizes to increase club visibility and attract members.","influence":0.3},{"agent":"Agent B","position":"Prioritizes spending the full budget on durable educational equipment and improved practice conditions.","influence":0.4},{"agent":"Agent C","position":"Supports an equal split between a smaller tournament and educational equipment to balance visibility and pedagogy.","influence":0.3}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"The options reflect legitimate but competing objectives, and none fully satisfies all stakeholders. Use a ranked social-choice vote with explicit criteria, while favoring a monitored hybrid allocation or phased decision that preserves essential equipment investment and provides limited outreach."}
